create_layer_relation_model: create a LayerRelation model instance with vocab, params, and optional regularizer for relation extraction
build_relation_extractor_tagger: build a RelationExtractor tagger with vocab, embedder, encoder, and hyperparameters d, l, n_classes, activation
run_model_forward_pass: run the LayerRelation forward pass on a tensor batch with optional training mode and task name
get_relation_extraction_metrics: get relation extraction metrics from the LayerRelation model with optional reset and full output
instantiate_model_from_params: instantiate a LayerRelation model from vocab and Params configuration using from_params class method
